description: Royal Challengers Bengaluru secured a dramatic last-ball victory against Mumbai Indians, propelling them to the top of the IPL 2026 table. Krunal Pandya's heroic 73 and Bhuvneshwar Kumar's stellar bowling performance were pivotal in the thrilling chase, bringing RCB closer to a playoff berth.
title: 'We need to fight hard': Kohli’s dressing room speech goes viral - Watch

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce sparked fresh royal wedding speculation after attending Poppy Delevingne’s London birthday party alongside Princess Beatrice and Princess Eugenie. The appearance renewed interest in Swift’s growing connection to Britain’s royal circle, especially after Prince William attended her Eras Tour in 2024. While rumours continue about possible royal wedding guests, no official details or confirmed invitations have emerged. Fans, however, remain convinced Swift and Kelce’s London social life hints at deeper royal ties.
title: Royal wedding buzz grows around Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce romance

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Pakistan pacer Shaheen Afridi faced scrutiny during the Bangladesh Test for allegedly tampering with the ball, though umpires found no issue. The match saw Bangladesh build a lead of 179 runs by stumps on Day 4, with key partnerships and individual milestones reached. Both teams expressed confidence in chasing victory on the final day.
title: Ball tampering? Shaheen Afridi caught pressing ball with spikes, umpire steps in

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Pakistan reportedly sheltered Iranian military aircraft at its airbases, raising questions about its neutrality as a mediator in the US-Iran conflict. US officials cited in a CBS News report claim Iran moved planes, including a reconnaissance jet, to Pakistan's Nur Khan Air Base. A Pakistani official denied these allegations, calling them implausible.
title: Despite mediation role, Pak allowed Iran to use Nur Khan airbase to avoid American strikes
